days6To15.title: UK Outlook for Monday 16 Nov 2026 to Wednesday 25 Nov 2026
days6To15.text: Following the tail end of the colder, more settled conditions seen over the weekend, a marked transition to more changeable conditions is expected at the start of the period. This will allow areas of low pressure to move in from the Atlantic and bring bands of rain and periods of windy weather. There will be some brighter, showery spells in-between however, particularly in the north. Overall, this period is likely to be wetter than average for the majority of the country. And whilst colder conditions will be possible at times, it will often be mild, with temperatures near or a little above average for the time of year.

days16To30.title: UK Outlook for Thursday 26 Nov 2026 to Thursday 10 Dec 2026
days16To30.text: Changeable or unsettled conditions are expected initially, with Atlantic weather systems bringing spells of rain and strong winds at times, interspersed with brighter, showery periods. Through late-November, low pressure may become slower-moving to the west of the UK, potentially bringing more prolonged rainfall, particularly to southern and western areas, along with a continued risk of strong winds. Into December, confidence becomes low, but there is a possibility that low pressure tracks shift further south as high pressure builds to the north. This could bring further rain at times to central and southern areas, while northern parts become somewhat drier. Temperatures will probably be near or slightly above average in the south, with an increasing chance of colder conditions extending southwards from the north into December.

Through late-November, low pressure may become slower-moving to the west of the UK, potentially bringing more prolonged rainfall, particularly to southern and western areas, along with a continued risk of strong winds. Into December, confidence becomes low, but there is a possibility that low pressure tracks shift further south as high pressure builds to the north. This could bring further rain at times to central and southern areas, while northern parts become somewhat drier. Temperatures will probably be near or slightly above average in the south, with an increasing chance of colder conditions extending southwards from the north into December.

regional.title: West Midlands
regional.headline: Plenty of autumnal sunshine but feeling cold with patchy frost.

sections.title: This Evening and Tonight:
sections.text: It will be dry overnight with cloudier skies in the south at first, but becoming clear across the region with temperatures falling away. It will feel cold compared to Tuesday night with patchy frost by dawn.

sections.title: Thursday:
sections.text: A chilly and bright start, with plenty of autumnal sunshine throughout Thursday. Feeling colder than Wednesday, especially in the northerly breeze with a widespread frost.developing overnight.

sections.title: Outlook for Friday to Sunday:
sections.text: Another crisp autumnal day on Friday after a frosty start. It turns cloudier during the weekend with temperatures creeping up, dry at first but some showers possible on Sunday.

national.title: The United Kingdom
national.headline: A sunny and cold end to the week for most.

sections.title: This Evening and Tonight:
sections.text: Becoming increasingly clear in the south. Clear spells and blustery showers along exposed northern coasts, and wintry showers over Scottish hills. Fog likely for some north England valleys. Gales arriving in the far northeast. Cold, with frost in the north.

sections.title: Thursday:
sections.text: Sunny with a chilly breeze for most. Spells of blustery showers and strong winds along northern and eastern coasts, with snow for Scottish hills, and gales for northeast Scotland.

sections.title: Outlook for Friday to Sunday:
sections.text: On Friday, long sunny spells in the south and east but showers in the northwest. Increasingly cloudy through the weekend, with showers and rain spreading from the west.

days6To15.title: UK Outlook for Monday 16 Nov 2026 to Wednesday 25 Nov 2026
days6To15.text: Following the tail end of the colder, more settled conditions seen over the weekend, a marked transition to more changeable conditions is expected at the start of the period. This will allow areas of low pressure to move in from the Atlantic and bring bands of rain and periods of windy weather. There will be some brighter, showery spells in-between however, particularly in the north. Overall, this period is likely to be wetter than average for the majority of the country. And whilst colder conditions will be possible at times, it will often be mild, with temperatures near or a little above average for the time of year.
